sources.entry: MailVeri MCP - Open-source MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor and other agents verify single emails and bulk lists via the MailVeri API (SMTP, catch-all, disposable and role detection). #freemium #opensource #mcp

summary.one_liner: MailVeri MCP is an open-source MCP server that lets agents such as Claude and Cursor verify single emails and bulk lists through the MailVeri API.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes MailVeri's email verification features to AI agents and MCP-compatible clients. According to the listing description, it lets Claude, Cursor and other agents verify single email addresses and bulk lists. The listing says verification covers SMTP checks, catch-all detection, disposable address detection and role address detection. Those checks are performed by the MailVeri API, not locally by this code. The README was not available, so details such as exact tool names, configuration or supported clients could not be confirmed.
use_cases: verify an email address from inside an AI assistant
clean a bulk contact list before sending a campaign
detect disposable or temporary email signups
flag role addresses like info@ or sales@
check catch-all domains during lead validation
notable: Plugs email verification directly into MCP clients like Claude and Cursor
Covers SMTP, catch-all, disposable and role address checks, per the listing
Handles both single-address and bulk-list verification, per the listing
caveats: README not available; setup steps and tool details could not be confirmed
Verification depends on the MailVeri API, which the listing describes as freemium (paid tiers likely apply)
